dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Warrior
dialogues.text: These monsters are tough. If it wasn't for your help, I don't know what I would've done.

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Warrior
dialogues.text: Hmm. Well, allow me to give this to you as gratitude. Please, do not refuse. And now, if you would excuse me, I shall have to check on my wounded comrades now...
